sql.postalCode.getZones: select id, company_id, zone_name, archived from flow.postal_code_zone where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by zone_name
sql.postalCode.getZone: select pcz.id, pcz.company_id, pcz.zone_name, pcz.archived, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(users))) FROM ( select pczu.id, pczu.user_id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as "fullName", pczu.postal_code_zone_id as "postalCodeZoneId", pczu.allocation, pczu.archived from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow."user" u on u.id = pczu.user_id where pczu.postal_code_zone_id = pcz.id and pczu.archived is not true order by allocation desc, u.first_name, u.last_name ) AS users), '[]') AS postalCodeZoneUsers, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(postalCodes))) FROM ( select pc.id, pc.postal_code as "postalCode", pc.postal_code_zone_id as "postalCodeZoneId", pc.archived from flow.postal_code pc where pc.postal_code_zone_id = pcz.id and pc.archived is not true order by pc.postal_code ) AS postalCodes), '[]') AS postalCodes from flow.postal_code_zone pcz where pcz.id = :id
sql.postalCode.insertZone: insert into flow.postal_code_zone(company_id, zone_name, date_created, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :zoneName, now(), :createdById)
sql.postalCode.updateZone: update flow.postal_code_zone set zone_name = :zoneName, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.deleteZone: update flow.postal_code_zone set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.insertZoneUser: insert into flow.postal_code_zone_user(postal_code_zone_id, user_id, date_created, created_by_id, allocation) values (:postalCodeZoneId, :userId, now(), :createdById, :allocation)
sql.postalCode.updateZoneUser: update flow.postal_code_zone_user set allocation = :allocation, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.deleteZoneUser: update flow.postal_code_zone_user set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.getZoneUser: select pczu.id, pczu.postal_code_zone_id, pczu.allocation, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, pczu.user_id, pczu.archived from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu inner join flow."user" u on u.id = pczu.user_id where pczu.id = :id
sql.postalCode.addZoneCode: insert into flow.postal_code(postal_code_zone_id, postal_code, date_created, created_by_id) values (:postalCodeZoneId, :postalCode, now(), :createdById)
sql.postalCode.deleteZoneCode: update flow.postal_code set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.postalCode.getZoneCode: select pc.id, pc.postal_code_zone_id, pc.postal_code, pc.archived from flow.postal_code pc where pc.id = :id
sql.postalCode.getZoneUsers: select distinct upv.user_id as id, upv.first_name, upv.last_name, upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name as full_name, upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name as title from flow.user_positions_vw upv where upv.position_schedulable is true and case when :isParent and :isSchedulingTool then array[upv.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else (upv.company_id = :companyId OR (:isSchedulingTool AND upv.company_id = :parentCompanyId AND upv.available_to_children is true )) end and upv.position_schedulable is true and upv.user_archived is not true and not exists (select user_id from flow.postal_code_zone_user pczu where postal_code_zone_id = :zoneId and pczu.user_id = upv.user_id and archived is not true) order by full_name
sql.postalCode.checkForExisting: select pc.id, pc.postal_code_zone_id, pc.postal_code, pc.archived from flow.postal_code pc where pc.postal_code = :postalCode and archived is not true
